mapper.select: select CONCAT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.shipment_date, 23), ' - ', a.seq ) AS shipmentDateSeq ,a.shipment_id ,a.shipment_date ,a.seq ,a.shipment_req_date ,a.shipment_time ,a.client_id ,b.client_name ,a.delivery_location ,a.delivery_address ,a.delivery_manager_name ,a.delivery_telno ,a.shipment_type ,a.shipment_yn ,a.managed_item ,a.attach_file_id ,a.etc ,a.print_yn ,a.shipment_status from tb_shipment_mst a left join tb_client_mst b on b.client_id = a.client_id where a.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}

select a.item_cd ,a.po_no ,a.lot_No ,a.make_no ,a.qc_status ,a.qty ,a.stock_qty ,a.pallet ,a.test_no ,a.storage_cd ,b.item_name ,a.shipment_item_id ,a.shipment_id ,a.item_type_cd ,'' as etc from tb_shipment_item a join tb_item_mst b on b.item_cd = a.item_cd where shipment_id = #{shipmentId}

select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY po_no, work_proc_id, storage_cd ) AS row_id , q.* from ( select a.po_no ,d.code_nm as item_type_name ,a.item_cd ,c.item_type_cd ,c.item_name ,b.lot_no ,b.make_no ,sum(e.qty) as stock_qty ,sum(0) as pallet ,d1.code_nm as passStateName ,f.storage_name ,f.storage_cd ,a.work_proc_id ,t.pass_state as qc_status ,a.test_no from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a inner join TB_WORK_ORDER_BATCH b on b.work_batch_id = a.work_batch_id inner join tb_item_mst c on c.item_cd = a.item_cd LEFT join tb_item_test_no t on t.test_no = a.test_no left join tb_common_code d on d.code = c.item_type_cd and d.com_type_cd = 'item_type_cd' left join tb_common_code d1 on d1.code = t.pass_state and d1.com_type_cd = 'pass_state' left join vw_inv_stock_tran e on e.item_cd = a.item_cd left join tb_storage_mst f on f.storage_cd = e.storage_cd where a.proc_cd = #{procCd} and a.proc_status = #{procStatus}
and a.po_no like '%' + #{poNo} + '%'
and c.item_cd like '%' + #{itemCd} + '%'
and c.item_name like '%' + #{itemName} + '%'
and NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_shipment_item x join tb_shipment_mst m on m.shipment_id = x.shipment_id WHERE x.po_no = a.po_no and x.work_proc_id = a.work_proc_id AND m.shipment_yn ='N' ) group by a.po_no ,d.code_nm ,a.item_cd ,c.item_name ,b.lot_no ,b.make_no ,d1.code_nm ,f.storage_name ,f.storage_cd ,a.work_proc_id ,t.pass_state ,a.test_no ,c.item_type_cd ) q
mapper.insert: insert into tb_shipment_inv_tran (shipment_item_id, tran_id, reg_id) values (#{tranId}, #{tranId}, #{userId})
mapper.select:
SELECT a.item_cd ,a.po_no ,a.lot_no AS lotNo ,a.make_no ,a.qc_status ,a.qty ,a.stock_qty ,a.pallet ,a.test_no ,a.storage_cd ,b.item_name ,a.shipment_item_id ,a.shipment_id ,a.item_type_cd ,'' AS etc ,c.copy_no AS copyNo FROM tb_shipment_item a INNER JOIN tb_item_mst b ON b.item_cd = a.item_cd
CROSS JOIN ( SELECT 1 AS copy_no UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS copy_no ) c
WHERE a.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
ORDER BY c.copy_no ,a.shipment_item_id
mapper.update: update tb_shipment_mst set print_yn ='Y' where shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
